import sys, json
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tests')
from lib import *

# 1. keys buffer, install drains in arrival order, discard drops
evs = [
    dg(1, 1200, [pkt("H", 0, [F("CRYPTO", offset=0, data_hex="01")]),
                 pkt("A", 0, [F("PING")]),
                 pkt("H", 1, [F("CRYPTO", offset=1, data_hex="02")])]),
    key(2, "H", "install"),
    key(3, "A", "install"),
]
got = one(evs)
print("1:", json.dumps(view(got)))

# 2. discard drops pending at key event time
evs = [
    key(0, "H", "discard"),
    dg(1, 1200, [pkt("H", 0, [F("PING")])]),
]
got = one(evs)
print("2:", json.dumps(view(got)))

# 3. buffer full (buffer_packets=1)
evs = [dg(5, 1200, [pkt("H", 0, [F("PING")]), pkt("A", 0, [F("PING")]),
                    pkt("H", 1, [F("PING")])])]
got = one(evs, buffer_packets=1)
print("3:", json.dumps(view(got)))

# 4. buffered at EOF
got = one([dg(7, 1200, [pkt("A", 3, [F("PING")])])])
print("4:", json.dumps(view(got)))

# 5. LAYOUT: A not final
got = one([dg(1, 1200, [pkt("A", 0, [F("PING")]), pkt("I", 0, [F("PING")])])])
print("5:", json.dumps(view(got)))

# 6. LAYOUT ok when A is final
got = one([key(0, "A", "install"),
           dg(1, 1200, [pkt("I", 0, [F("PING")]), pkt("A", 0, [F("PING")])])])
print("6:", json.dumps(view(got)))

# 7. INITIAL_TOO_SMALL
got = one([dg(1, 1199, [pkt("I", 0, [F("PING")]), pkt("A", 0, [F("PING")])])])
print("7:", json.dumps(view(got)))
got = one([dg(1, 1199, [pkt("I", 0, [F("PING")]), pkt("I", 1, [F("PING")])])], early=True)
print("7b:", json.dumps(view(got)))

# 8. early rejection / acceptance
got = one([dg(1, 1200, [pkt("Z", 0, [F("STREAM", id=0, offset=0, data_hex="61", fin=False)])])])
print("8:", json.dumps(view(got)))
got = one([dg(1, 1200, [pkt("Z", 0, [F("STREAM", id=0, offset=0, data_hex="61", fin=False)])])], early=True)
print("8b:", json.dumps(view(got)))

# 9. AUTH drop then retransmit accepted
got = one([dg(1, 1200, [pkt("I", 0, [F("PING")], auth=False)]),
           dg(2, 1200, [pkt("I", 0, [F("PING")])])])
print("9:", json.dumps(view(got)))

# 10. duplicates: Z and A share space
got = one([key(0, "A", "install"),
           dg(1, 1200, [pkt("A", 5, [F("PING")])]),
           dg(2, 1200, [pkt("Z", 5, [F("PING")])])], early=True)
print("10:", json.dumps(view(got)))

# 11. install no-op when live; install after discard no-op
got = one([key(1, "H", "install"), key(2, "H", "install"), key(3, "H", "discard"),
           key(4, "H", "install"), dg(5, 1200, [pkt("H", 0, [F("PING")])])])
print("11:", json.dumps(view(got)))

sys.exit(1 if summary() else 0)
